title: Greek Baklava with Crunchy Nut Topping
description: A sweet and crunchy twist on the classic Greek pastry dessert. Layers of flaky phyllo, crunchy nuts, and sweet honey come together in a delightful treat.
instructions: Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions.
Layer phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each sheet with melted butter.
Sprinkle chopped walnuts and crushed biscuits over the phyllo layers.
Drizzle honey over the top layer of phyllo.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm or at room temperature, topped with a dollop of Greek yogurt and chopped baklava.
